notes.title: Update Notes (ver.1.1)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The Zombie Police development team here.

We've just released an update for Zombie Police.

Here's what's new:

[b]- New Side Story:[/b] "Convenience Store Chatter" is now available! Access it from "OMAKE" on the title screen after clearing Chapter 3. More side stories are planned for future free updates.

[b]- Improved Localization:[/b] We've improved the English translation and added French language support. Please note that the French translation is currently in beta and will be further refined in future updates.

[b]- Performance Improvements:[/b] Enjoy a smoother gameplay experience thanks to various optimizations.

[b]- UI Updates:[/b] Added a fullscreen option and a "Return to Title" button to the config menu.

We're committed to providing the best possible experience and will continue to improve Zombie Police. Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Update Notes (ver.1.01)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

Today, we have updated "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies".
Here are the details:

[b]- System Fix[/b]
Fixed a bug where the text speed would reset to default when restarting the game.

[b]- Performance Improvement[/b]
Implemented measures to address the issue of screen flickering that occurred when clicking in specific scenes.
We will continue to work on improvements to ensure a smooth gaming experience.

[b]- Simplified Chinese Translation Update[/b]
Improved the Simplified Chinese translation to enhance your enjoyment of the story.

[b]- Other Improvements[/b]
Addressed various minor issues and made other improvements.
And we have passed the Steam Deck compatibility check and is now verified to play on Steam Deck.

Added on 9/11
We have again fixed the issue where certain lines were not displaying properly in the Windows version.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

The development team would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all the players who have played "Zombie Police" since its release and taken the time to leave reviews.
Thank you for your continued support of "Zombie Police".

notes.title: Demo Version Update (Mac & Simplified Chinese)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

Today, we have updated the demo version of  "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies".
[list][*]Added macOS version
[*]Improved the translation for the Simplified Chinese version[/list]For users of the Simplified Chinese version, if you had installed the demo before this update, please uninstall it first and then reinstall the updated version before launching the game.

We hope that with this update, even more people will be able to enjoy "Zombie Police".

Additionally, we are currently running the [Zombie Police: Demo Campaign] where players who have tried the demo version have a chance to win a Steam key for the full version of the game.
You can choose to enter either the "Gameplay Video Category" or the "Play Impression Category".
For more details, please check out the news page below:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2825070/view/6018578477456594043
If you have any other feedback or questions about the demo version, we would greatly appreciate it if you could share them on our Steam community page:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2825070/discussions/0/6471190240000443455/


The entire development team looks forward to receiving your feedback and impressions.

notes.title: Demo Version Release
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is the "Zombie Police" development team.

Today, we are excited to announce the release of the demo version of "Zombie Police: Christmas Dancing with Police Zombies".
Join Detective Tamura and Detective Zomby, as you unravel the truth behind the mysterious fall at the Namino Hotel!

Please note that the macOS version is currently under adjustment.
We sincerely apologize to our Mac users for the inconvenience.
We kindly ask for your patience as we work to complete the necessary adjustments.

Furthermore, we are planning to update the Simplified Chinese localization to provide a more natural and easily understandable translation.

The entire development team looks forward to receiving your feedback and impressions.
